title: GET /api/mxl/v1/state
description: Live switcher state: what's on program (PGM), what's armed on preview (PVW), the keyer, and the busy lock. Also the response body of /v1/cut, /preview, /take, /key (every mutating route returns the new state). Sources are referenced by stable id (see sources.schema.json).

pgm.description: Source id currently on air, or null if the on-air flow isn't a known source. Replaces the old integer 'input' (a layout index).

pvw.description: Source id armed on the preview bus, or null if nothing armed. Pure server-side state until a take.

busy.description: A switch is in progress; a cut/take right now returns error.code=busy (retryable).

test_source.description: Present only when the 'test-source' capability is offered. The generator pattern state (was status.patterns.tg1, with the internal 'tg1' process name dropped).
